title: ionidium glutinosum var. parviflorum
intro: Ionidium glutinosum var. parviflorum, commonly known as Sichuan Ionidium, is a plant species in the genus Ionidium. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Sichuan Ionidium include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sichuan Ionidium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
